page.overview:
What is Combat Knife?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Combat_knife Combat Knife] is a fighting knife designed solely for military use and primarily intended for hand-to-hand or close combat fighting.

Since the end of trench warfare, most military combat knives have been secondarily designed for utility use (clearing foliage, chopping branches for cover, opening ammunition crates, etc.) in addition to their original role as close-quarter combat weapons, and may be referred to as "fighting-utility knives". On the other hand, military knives that are intended primarily for use in a role other than combat are typically referred to by their primary role, such as "utility knife" or "survival knife".

Within the series, many characters have used Combat Knives in their arsenal. Kano is notorious for using an assortment of knives throughout his appearances in the series, ranging from Butterfly Knives, Bowie knives, Throwing Knives, Elbow Blades and Boot Blades. In Mortal Kombat 11, Kano's knives are referred to as Shanks and are part of his Gear and can be customized in the game's Kustomization.

Characters have also used Combat Knives within other aspects of the series, such as during cutscenes in their respective game's Story Modes but never in actual gameplay.
